result.paraphrase: Viper Gaming’s VPN100 combines top-tier performance, ultra-fast speed, and multitasking power. At 5x the speed of SATA SSDs, it is a best-in-class reliability drive for gamers, tech enthusiasts, content creators, and video rendering professionals who want blazing startup times and immediate data access for improved productivity. The Viper VPN100 M.2 SSD uses an external thermal sensor to reduce overheating and prevent performance drops, and it also features a built-in aluminum heat shield plus 8 thermal fins for excellent thermal dissipation. Delivering superior performance and maximum reliability, the VPN100 is an ideal choice for all-in-one PC kits, small-form-factor systems, and high-performance gaming PC builds. Supported by Patriot’s award-winning build quality and a 3-year warranty, the Patriot VPN100 stands out as one of the most dependable performance-class SSDs. Capacity: 1TB.
